The blog page has a longer Time to First Byte (TTFB) of 136.4 ms, suggesting that the server response time could be improved. Investigate potential issues such as slow database queries or server configuration.
Although all passed pages have acceptable load times, it is essential to continuously monitor and optimize performance to ensure a positive user experience and maintain good search engine rankings.
